text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year! Wishing everyone even 
greater success this year—cheers!

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers!

"On New Year's Day of our Classic Year, I 
was invited by Duramente's family to 
attend a party where the entire clan 
gathered."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Once again, Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate B
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san, it's almost time!
choice_data_list: Knock that speech out of the park!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

Duramente is taking on the Classic races 
this year. Approaching such a critical 
turning point, she had been entrusted with 
delivering the keynote speech at the 
party.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
—Just as with all of you, many of my 
family members have achieved glorious 
results as athletes.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
The same holds true in the racing world. 
Many magnificent Umamusume have left 
behind brilliant achievements over the 
years—

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
"GⅠ victories, Classic sweeps, 
parent-and-child victories in the very 
same race... Umamusume who have brought 
all manner of glory to their bloodlines."

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
However, the peak that no one could ever 
reach... That is none other than the 
world—the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
Our long-cherished wish, victory in the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... An Umamusume 
willing to take on that challenge has 
appeared once again this year.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the introduction. I am 
Duramente.
(Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As we discussed earlier, I will be taking 
on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe this 
year.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"As a preparatory step, we will aim for 
the Classic Triple Crown route."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby, in particular... is a 
race very close to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Watching the Nippon Derby one year taught 
me what it truly means to be the 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—"The strongest has descended AT THIS VERY 
MOMENTTT!!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In other words, leaving all others in the 
dust. An overwhelming, vivid victory that 
pulls away from everyone—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—The strongest. No other word can possibly 
be given.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Becoming a Derby Umamusume—the honor and 
dream of all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And to do so with overwhelming 
dominance... Alongside winning the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe, that is another dream 
of mine.

The Japanese Derby, a race Duramente 
longed for... Without a doubt, the 
winner's strength was overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"—She takes the lead! She's out in front! 
After an epic duel to the finish— the 
absolute strongest has descended!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"The winning time is unbelievable! 2 
minutes 23.3 seconds! A new Derby record! 
She shaved two whole seconds off the 
previous record!"

On this day of an exceptionally fast 
track, as each Umamusume pushed her speed 
to the absolute limit, the top ten 
finishers all broke the course record—

Perhaps running back-to-back races in such 
a short span, from the NHK Mile to the 
Derby, took its toll... She retired due to 
injury. Of course, that probably wasn't 
the only factor, but...

The ultimate running style she speaks of 
is a double-edged sword. If mastered, it 
will certainly make her an overwhelming 
victor. However, it also carries serious 
hazards, including the risk of injury.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This year, I will surely live up to 
everyone's... no, to history's 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—I would be honored if you would watch 
over me.
(Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Duramente, that was a 
magnificent speech!

She is the chairwoman of Tracen Academy. 
She shouldn't have any relation to the 
Duramente clan... Why is she attending?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"There is an Umamusume I'm personally 
close with! She invited me!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, as the academy's 
chairwoman... I have always resonated 
deeply with their philosophy of constantly 
challenging the world!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Making our presence known on the world 
stage will surely benefit all of Japan's 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I declare! I love racing and Umamusume 
from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Having a Japanese Umamusume stand at the 
top of the world is my own dream as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I promise! The academy is 
prepared to support you as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Just like all the Umamusume who've 
challenged it before! You can always lean 
on me!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. I promise you that 
I will live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! Mm-hmm! Do your very best!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, my friend is calling for me! If 
you'll excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate C
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll be watching over you through the 
Classic year too. Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much.

Even after parting with Chairwoman 
Akikawa, Duramente was approached by 
numerous officials. Their words of 
encouragement were uniformly kind—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Warm, huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"They all know the harsh reality of 
sports. I'm sure they understand my 
resolve."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Without needing to say much at all. ...I 
am truly grateful.

Duramente's deep devotion to her 
lineage... I felt as though I had touched 
upon a piece of why it came to be.

Just then... the crowd parted down the 
middle, and for a split second, I caught a 
glimpse of the face of the person at the 
center.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah, the one in the black hat.
choice_data_list:
Wait, aren't you that super legendary 
Trainer...?!

Aren't you that super legendary 
Trainer...?!

text_block_list.text:
He burned with passion for racing from its 
dawn, building an entire era as a Trainer. 
Everyone stands upon the history he 
created.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
They have had close ties with my family 
for generations. When I told them I wanted 
to challenge the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, they were truly delighted.

"……I brace myself once more. A peak that 
even such an exceptional Trainer couldn't 
reach…… We carry those feelings upon our 
shoulders as well."
choice_data_list: (I should ask for an autograph later...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, it's time for our annual New 
Year's sports festival.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
After a party, we exercise vigorously. It 
is an ancient tradition passed down in our 
clan.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to participate, I have 
received instructions from my father to 
support you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I won't force you. But moving your body 
with everything you've got feels great.
choice_data_list: In that case... maybe I should join in?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Which one do you want to enter? I'll go 
with your choice.

Looking at the list Duramente presented, 
there were serious athletic sports as well 
as casual, lighthearted events like those 
at a sports festival.
choice_data_list: Duramente will sit this one out

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. Your perspective is truly 
unique.
choice_data_list:
No, I guess that's to be expected, or 
rather—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'll go register us right away. You go 
ahead and warm up.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—I will rewrite the great records of my 
father and mother.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Pair Speed," a unique competition 
originating from our clan's history, born 
from the bond between Umamusume and 
humans...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume and a human form a pair, 
passing the baton that symbolizes their 
bond and aiming for the finish line at top 
speed!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No. It's "Pair Speed."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
My father and mother set new records in 
this sport. Records that remain unbroken 
to this day.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "You and I are going to rewrite that."
choice_data_list: Your father is an athlete, isn't he?!
Your father is an athlete, isn't he?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No problem. ――Who will you pass the baton 
to?
(Ooooohh...!?)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Wh-What an unbelievable turn of events! 
The first runner was indeed dead last by a 
mile when passing the baton to her...”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
However, the first to cross the finish 
line is Duramente! She snatches victory 
with an astonishing final burst of 
speed—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here is the rising star of the current 
generation! Behold the power of Duramente! 
...Nice fight to you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Next year, I will rewrite the record.

Duramente's eyes burned with a quiet 
flame. While pretending not to notice... I 
resolved to secretly put in some extra 
running sessions.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What does this mean?

Duramente has already fulfilled the major 
duty of giving a speech today. It's best 
to let her rest both mind and body.
choice_data_list:
I'll do my best on my own, so please watch 
over me!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...I see. So, what are you entering?"

"If possible, I'd like to participate in 
an event that helps me understand 
Duramente better. With that in mind, what 
caught my eye was—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Every single runner in this race is a 
world-class athlete.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Is everyone ready? Trainer, are you all 
good, too?”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's start the medium-distance 
run! On your mark, get set... GO!

"It's been a while since I ran with all my 
might, and the result was—!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Dead last. Just as expected. No miracles 
happened here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the drive you showed at the start 
took me by surprise. ...You ran a great 
race. Good job.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see, doubles, huh. ...I have no 
experience taking part in that.
choice_data_list:
Since we're at it, let's do something we 
can do together!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Understood. In that case—

Duramente chose table tennis. It was 
certainly an easier sport for an ordinary 
person to pick up compared to the others.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'll support you from the back. Feel free 
to go for a smash whenever you're ready.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll lean on you a whole bunch.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll position myself so you can hit 
properly. It's a rare opportunity, so 
enjoy it."

...Despite having said that, once the 
match began, Duramente—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Phewwww!!
(WHOOSH...!)

text_block_list.name: Opposing Umamusume Player
text_block_list.text:
Nice smash, Duramente-san...! Now, let's 
see if you can return this serve!
(SWOOSH...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. This is getting interesting.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Break's over. Let's continue.

text_block_list.name: Opposing Umamusume Player
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Opposing Player
text_block_list.text:
...I tell them every year to only form 
doubles pairs with other Umamusume. But 
they just won't listen, insisting 'We can 
do it!'
choice_data_list: I'll give my input later too...

I'll put in a word about it later as 
well...

text_block_list.text:
After that, we watched the heated 
"doubles" match for a while.
